case.name: Autonomous Market Research Agent
case.business_problem: Produce an evidence-backed market research brief. The model uses a known set of search and retrieval tools, evaluates intermediate results, chooses follow-up queries and decides when sufficient evidence has been gathered.
case.desired_outcome: A structured research brief with citations, assembled without a human manually orchestrating each data source for every request.
case.quality_target: High factual grounding with citations; completeness over the research topic
case.latency_target: Minutes, not seconds - this is an asynchronous research task, not a chat turn
case.cost_constraint: Moderate - a handful of research runs per week, not high-volume
case.regulatory_constraints: None - internal strategic use, no customer-facing output
case.roi_notes: Illustrative assumptions, not measurements: Productivity: cuts a roughly one-day manual research task down to under an hour of review time. Solution cost: dominated by tool/API calls across sources, scales with research volume, not headcount.

option_scores.name: Workflow with a fixed source list

tradeoff_notes: Agent autonomy is proposed because retrieved evidence determines follow-up queries, repetition and termination, not because the tool catalog is large or unknown. The same small tool set can support this exploratory trajectory. Compare with a workflow if the required research steps and stopping rules can instead be scripted; validate any quality gain against latency, cost and error propagation. Multiple agents are not justified solely by different source types.
